title: 4,500 in 5 Minutes! BEST New MOB XP Farm for Minecraft 1.21+
description: In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to build a new style mob XP farm that takes advantage of modern spawning and movement behavior to keep mobs flowing smoothly with minimal downtime. The design uses a simple multi stage drop chamber that keeps mobs moving instantly into the kill zone, which boosts overall efficiency and keeps XP and drops coming in consistently. The result is a mob farm that’s fast, simple, and cheap, making it one of the strongest options you can build in Minecraft right now.
